Congratulations on completing this path! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Opened and named your alert rule
- Switched the query editor to Code mode
- Wrote a PromQL error-rate query using two `rate()` calls and a ratio
- Set the alert condition and threshold
- Created a folder and added a routing label
- Configured the evaluation group and pending period
- Configured no-data and error handling, and set a recovery threshold
- Selected a contact point
- Added a summary and description to your notification
- Saved and activated your alert rule
You now have a working alert rule that reaches for a pattern the visual builder can't compose in one query. That's the real power of Code mode.
